Siri AI is the major upgrade and highlight feature of iOS 27 and later, but only newer Apple device models support the all-new Siri. Below is the complete list of iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch and Apple Vision Pro hardware that supports Siri AI.

The following Apple products support Siri AI on iOS 27 and later

iOS 27 and its accompanying updates include the long-awaited major Siri overhaul, a feature called Siri AI.

Siri AI is only available on compatible hardware (and in specific regions). Below are all the Apple products that support Siri AI.

iPhone

  • iPhone Duo
  • iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max
  • iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max
  • iPhone Air
  • iPhone 17
  • iPhone 17e
  • iPhone 16 Pro and Pro Max
  • iPhone 16 and 16 Plus
  • iPhone 16e
  • iPhone 15 Pro and Pro Max

iPad

  • iPad Pro (M1 chip and later models)
  • iPad Air (M1 chip and later models)
  • iPad mini (A17 Pro)

Mac

  • All models equipped with Apple silicon (M1 chip and later, as well as the A18 Pro chip)

Apple Watch (must be used with an AI-capable iPhone)

  • Apple Watch Series 9 and later
  • Apple Watch Ultra 2 and later
  • Apple Watch SE 3

Apple Vision Pro

  • All models

All of the above products support Siri AI. However, some features of the Siri experience will perform better on specific models.

For example, the ability to fully customise Siri AI voice cadence and expressiveness is only available on certain hardware. Apple said:

The reason for this limitation is that Apple's most powerful on-device AI models are only available on newer products. Users who own these models may or may not notice faster Siri AI performance.

Does Siri AI make you want to upgrade to newer Apple hardware? Let us know in the comments.
